mission_prompt: Analyze the attached logs to identify the root cause, classify recurring errors by frequency/impact, and provide immediate remediation steps and an executive incident summary.

units.description: Create a realistic structured log dataset that includes timestamps, severity levels, component identifiers, error codes/messages, and contextual metadata. The synthetic logs should emulate common patterns such as authentication failures, timeout errors, resource exhaustion, and configuration mismatches to enable meaningful analysis.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A CSV or JSON file containing at least 5,000 log entries with diverse error types and timestamps spanning a realistic time window.

units.task_name: Analyze Errors: Frequency, Impact, and Root Cause Identification
units.description: Parse the synthesized log dataset to (1) count occurrences of each unique error code/message, (2) calculate impact scores based on severity and affected components, (3) cluster related errors to uncover underlying root causes, and (4) produce a ranked list of recurring issues.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A structured report (e.g., JSON or tabular format) listing error categories, frequency counts, impact scores, and inferred root‑cause hypotheses.

units.task_name: Generate Remediation Steps and Executive Incident Summary

units.output_contract: A two‑part output: (1) a bulleted remediation checklist with implementation guidance; (2) an executive briefing document suitable for senior leadership communication.
